tables.name: layers
tables.label: Map layers
tables.description: Every Atlas map layer with its data source, vintage and zoom range — the provenance ledger.

tables.name: run_config
tables.label: Model run setup
tables.description: One row: the scenario you want the model to run (year, growth, note) plus the connection settings (endpoint, token). Tap it on the Run screen to edit.

tables.name: runs
tables.label: Model runs
tables.description: The output ledger: one row per LIVE model run, appended when the server replies. when/year/growth/note are stamped from the configuration at insert.

tables.name: endpoint_info
tables.label: Endpoint health
tables.description: Latest /health reply from the model endpoint — replaced on every health check.

tables.name: results
tables.label: Model outputs
tables.description: One row per scenario x route/segment/metric. The cockpit reads these; every row carries run_id, model_version and confidence_tier.

tables.name: slices
tables.label: Saved views
tables.description: Named report configurations saved from the Cockpit (bookmark icon) — plain rows that sync/back up/export like any other data.

tables.name: shapes
tables.label: Custom shapes
tables.description: User geospatial polygons — drawn on the map or imported from GeoJSON / shapefile. Each carries geometry, provenance, and the insight the model stamps back (workers, jobs, households).

tables.name: zone_stats
tables.label: Zone layers (calculated)
tables.description: Per-town calculated values the Dashboard map paints as choropleth layers — trips from the ridership rows, cost per person-mile from the economics rows. Editable rows like everything else; refreshed when new model outputs land.
